d:
Vicky, a businessman, loves his younger brother Prem, who spends his time chasing women. The family feels that secretary Sapna will make a good wife for Vicky, but she is already in love with Prem.
Chal Mere Bhai is a 2000 Indian Hindi-language comedy film produced by Nitin Manmohan and directed by David Dhawan.
It stars Sanjay Dutt, Salman Khan and Karishma Kapoor.
Music of the film was composed by Anand Milind.
Movie - Chal Mere Bhai (2000)
Director - David Dhawan
Writers - Ikram Akhtar, Rumi Jaffery, Yunus Sajawal
